title: Japan invades northern French Indochina
summary: Japanese troops crossed from China into northern Vietnam and fought brief battles with French colonial forces around Lang Son before Vichy France accepted Japanese bases.
reason: Japan wanted to cut the supply route to Nationalist China through Haiphong and to gain a foothold in South-East Asia after France's defeat.
significance: It drew US economic sanctions on Japan and began the Japanese presence in Indochina that later fed the Vietnamese independence struggle.
